body_blocks: Hypothesis: ProofLaunch can help GTM leaders and founder-led growth teams pursue this outcome—one traceable path from a rights-bound brief to review-ready GTM artifacts—while addressing this problem—fragmented strategy, content, approval and measurement tools that slow execution and obscure accountability. Test that premise through this next step—review the end-to-end evidence pack and join the design-partner cohort—before scaling.
A governed GTM employee that binds evidence, generation, review, activation and learning without automatic external release.
What would GTM leaders and founder-led growth teams need to inspect before trusting this path?
call_to_action: Review the evidence, then decide whether to join the design-partner cohort.
preheader: A governed GTM employee that binds evidence, generation, review, activation and learning without automatic external release.
subject: Can the evidence carry the promise?
